title: Bill Galaty and Philly Ray
summary: He played with Galaty, calling him a fake player who was no great musician, and Ray as the hiring leader.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yes that's right. Galaty do you remember is it a Bill Galaty? Bill Galaty?
Did you ever play work with him to play music with him?
He played with Philly Ray too didn't he? Huh? Bill Galaty used to play with Philly Ray too didn't he? Yes.
Well Philly Ray used to play with him.
Well I mean. He used to hire him.
He was supposed to be the head knocker. But he was a fake player. He never studied no music.
How did he play? Huh? Bill Galaty. How did he play? Did he play good or bad?
Well he wasn't so bad but he wasn't so good either. But he always did try to get the best that he could get.
Yeah he's playing with him dancing. Mm-hmm.
I played a few times with him.
